# Backspace Fork 1.16.1

## New

- **Invite to Space:** right-click a friend or a one-on-one DM to select one of
  your spaces and send its invitation card. Reuses the existing federation-aware
  invitation flow, with localized labels in all five supported languages.
- Based on [upstream PR #485](https://github.com/TheZwiss/backspace/pull/485)
  by [@bonderaustria](https://github.com/bonderaustria), with fork fixes for
  coinciding space IDs across instances, duplicate input and obsolete operations
  after a modal, recipient or account-session change.

## Fixes and maintenance

- Includes fork PR #10: restores voice ownership after signaling reconnects,
  makes soundboard rate-limit consumption atomic, coordinates button/shortcut
  playback and guards pinned-message loading against stale state. Historical
  operational events without conclusive evidence remain documented, not claimed
  as resolved.
- Includes the dependency updates already merged in fork PR #9: Electron
  45.1.0, venmic 7.2.5 and react-router-dom 7.18.5.
- The existing invitation dialog ignores obsolete code lookups and send results
  instead of replacing a newer link or closing an unrelated modal.

## Operations

- No new database migration or API/federation protocol. Existing invitation
  permissions, friendship checks and join-request approval remain enforced.
- Preserve the database, uploads, environment secrets and instance identity.
  This release does not change existing server diagnostics or log rotation.
- Updating an installation is a separate operator action; publication does not
  restart or deploy to an existing server.
